title: 属性闭包 X+ 计算：Armstrong 公理的不动点迭代
expected_output:
=== 属性闭包 X+ 计算 ===
R = ABCDE
F = A->B, A->C, CD->E, B->D

X          X+           =R?     
A          ABCDE        YES     
B          BD           no      
C          C            no      
D          D            no      
BD         BD           no      
CD         CDE          no      
AE         ABCDE        YES     

判据: 若 X+ 含全部属性, 则 X 是超键(superkey)
A+ = ABCDE 走到 E 的路径: A->B, A->C, B->D, 再 CD->E
code:
# 属性闭包 X+ 的真实计算（Armstrong 公理的自反/增广/传递三条推出的不动点迭代）
def closure(attrs, fds):
    res = set(attrs)
    changed = True
    while changed:
        changed = False
        for lhs, rhs in fds:
            if lhs <= res and not rhs <= res:
                res |= rhs
                changed = True
    return res


def fmt(s):
    return "".join(sorted(s)) or "-"


print("=== 属性闭包 X+ 计算 ===")
attrs = {"A", "B", "C", "D", "E"}
fds = [
    (frozenset("A"), frozenset("B")),
    (frozenset("A"), frozenset("C")),
    (frozenset("CD"), frozenset("E")),
    (frozenset("B"), frozenset("D")),
]
print("R = " + fmt(attrs))
print("F = " + ", ".join("%s->%s" % (fmt(l), fmt(r)) for l, r in fds))
print()
print("%-10s %-12s %-8s" % ("X", "X+", "=R?"))
for x in ("A", "B", "C", "D", "BD", "CD", "AE"):
    cx = closure(frozenset(x), fds)
    print("%-10s %-12s %-8s" % (x, fmt(cx), "YES" if cx == attrs else "no"))
print()
print("判据: 若 X+ 含全部属性, 则 X 是超键(superkey)")
print("A+ = ABCDE 走到 E 的路径: A->B, A->C, B->D, 再 CD->E")
